verdict.rationale: Bevy's own docs list real-time 2D rendering as a core feature, and the repo ships a 2D 'breakout' example. A hands-on community user describes working directly with sprites (moving and rotating them, attaching labels), which suggests sprites are a usable native workflow. However, the evidence shows nothing on tilemaps or 2D physics, and nothing showing 2D is treated as a peer of the 3D renderer rather than a lighter feature. Missing for 10: tilemap support, built-in 2D physics, in-depth first-party docs on the sprite workflow, evidence that 2D is first-class rather than secondary to 3D.
